cases.task: Design and stress-test a deterministic router between Queue A (latency 2 minutes, capacity 20, no regulated data) and Queue B (latency 15 minutes, capacity 200, regulated data allowed). Requests have urgency low/high, regulated yes/no, and batch size 1..100. Return a compact rubric, routing pseudocode, three boundary cases, and an input-visibility matrix for any blind roles used.
cases.graderPrompt: Prefer a deterministic, complete router that never sends regulated data to Queue A, handles capacity and urgency honestly, tests meaningful boundaries, and preserves/discloses blind-role inputs. Return exactly WINNER_A, WINNER_B, or TIE followed by one concise reason.
